text: Corporate wrongdoers are unlikely to prefer regulation by prosecution over regulation by legislation because prosecution and execution of an agreement carry large reputational implications.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Timothy Lacine, The Effect of Deferred and Non-Prosecution Agreements on Corporate Governance Evidence from 1993-20 (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2486570

isBasedOn.name: The Effect of Deferred and Non-Prosecution Agreements on Corporate Governance Evidence from 1993-20

abstract: Because of the large reputational implications of prosecution and N/DPA execution, corporate wrongdoers are unlikely to favor "regulation by prosecution" to regulation by legislation.
